verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The permission and confidentiality features listed control team access, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
